scientific_limitations: This remains a retrospective conditional mapping on the published selected/processed cohort. Its historical processing or row selection may have used future observations; new prefix-safe code does not repair that ancestry.
Observed-subcohort means under attrition are not imputed means of an initial whole culture. Within-frame cell SD is descriptive and cells are not independent biological replicates.
Three train and two development cultures under one reported downshift do not establish causal glucose effects, dose generalization, intrinsic kinetic parameters or a universal biological law.

Original strong protocols/gates were not modified and remain scientifically blocked. No development metadata, synthetic fixture, successful optimizer or good development score grants a biological ready label.
No reserved raw data or real development responses were accessed; no external chronology, encryption, OS-level separation or production authority was invented.
